name: authoring-skills
description: Author a new agent skill or improve an existing one - write the SKILL.md frontmatter and description, structure the body, and fix skills that under- or over-trigger. Also covers writing or trimming AGENTS.md / CLAUDE.md project instruction files. Use when asked to create/write a skill, make a SKILL.md, improve/refactor a skill, fix a skill's description, or write, restructure, or shorten an AGENTS.md or CLAUDE.md.
